description: I am 10 years old, from Highlands Tamil School. I am interested in robotic and coding. I would like to create a game for kids to learn about space.
summary: I use scratch to create this project. This is game for kids and they will explore planet names.I took few planets name from Nasa open data for this game.Thank you.
details:
I refer to Nasa open data: https://data.nasa.gov/dataset/extrasolar-planets-encyclopedia.

I took few names of planets and add into scaratch programme and add coding to create a game. This is game for kids in kinddy or primary school . So,they will explore planet names.I use English language for game instruction and play game.I can add more planet in future. Thank you.
